title: Hold a stevedoring licence in a designated port
what: Carry on a stevedoring business within a designated port only under a licence.

sources.title: Ports Management Act 2015 (NT)
sources.quote: A person commits an offence if: (a) the person carries on a business of a stevedore; and (b) the business is carried on within a designated port

administration.who: Minister administering the Ports Management Act 2015 (NT)

sources.title: Ports Management Act 2015 (NT)
sources.locator: s 54(7), words naming the body (found 24 Nov 2026) (current reprint)
sources.quote: The Minister must not grant or renew a licence, or refuse to grant or renew a licence, to carry on a business of a stevedore within a designated port without first consulting the port operator of the port.
